setting_ko: 소라 씨가 아침에 전화를 안 받은 Jiwoo 씨를 찾아요

lines.en: Jiwoo! Where were you this morning? I called you twice.
lines.sp: Jiwoo! Where wer ya this mornin'? I called ya twice.
lines.hk: {NAME}! 웨얼 워려 디스 모닌? 아이 콜드여 트와이스.
lines.ko: Jiwoo 씨! 오늘 아침에 어디 있었어요? 두 번이나 전화했어요.

lines.en: Sorry! I was at the dentist. My phone was off.
lines.sp: Sorry! I wuz at the dentist. My phone wuz off.
lines.hk: 쏘리! 아이 워잿 더 덴티스트. 마이 폰 워저프.
lines.ko: 미안해요! 치과에 있었어요. 휴대폰이 꺼져 있었어요.

lines.en: No, it wasn't. It was just a checkup.
lines.sp: No, it wasn'. It wuz justa checkup.
lines.hk: 노, 잇 워즌. 잇 워즈 저스터 체껍.

lines.en: Good. We were at the new Thai restaurant last night.
lines.sp: Good. We wer at the new Thai restaurant las' night.
lines.hk: 굿. 위 워랫 더 뉴 타이 레스터런트 래스 나잇.
lines.ko: 다행이에요. 저희는 어젯밤에 새로 생긴 태국 음식점에 갔어요.

lines.en: The food was great, but the restaurant was full, so we waited.
lines.sp: The food wuz great, but the restaurant wuz full, so we waided.
lines.hk: 더 푸드 워즈 그레잇, 벗 더 레스터런트 워즈 풀, 쏘 위 웨이리드.
lines.ko: 음식은 아주 맛있었는데 식당이 꽉 차서 기다렸어요.

lines.en: About forty minutes! But it was worth it.
lines.sp: About fordy minutes! Bud-it wuz worth it.
lines.hk: 어바웃 포리 미닛츠! 버릿 워즈 워쓰잇.
